import csv

total_units = 0

    for row in reader:
        if row['region'] == 'North':
            total_units += int(row['units'])

print(total_units)

    header = lines[0].strip().split(',')
    region_idx = header.index('region')
    units_idx = header.index('units')
    
    for line in lines[1:]:
        cols = line.strip().split(',')
        if cols[region_idx] == 'North':
            total_units += int(cols[units_idx])

print(total_units)
